plate.explanation: Choose plate for a rectangular mounting blank with positioned through-holes. Width/depth define the XY outline, height sets thickness, and optional holes remove material through both faces. Produces checked STL, generated SCAD and a geometry summary.

spacer.explanation: Choose spacer for a concentric sleeve or washer. Supply outer diameter, bore diameter and height in mm; it is centred on XY origin and extends upwards from Z=0. Polygonal walls approximate circles, so across-flats bore clearance differs from nominal diameter.

fields.explanation: Describe one dimensioned part using plate or spacer, explicit millimetres, and a matching dimensions object. Parts are bounded polygon extrusions with no authored SCAD or arbitrary constructive tree; verified outputs support dimension studies and explicit-unit geometry exchange.

/properties/version.explanation: Select schemaxis.openscad/1, the JSON input language version. This is distinct from the separately qualified stable native OpenSCAD 2021.01 release.

/properties/operation.explanation: Choose plate for a rectangular blank with positioned through-holes, or spacer for a concentric annulus. Supply exactly the matching plate/spacer dimensions object; changing this selector alone may leave the draft incomplete.

/properties/units.explanation: Declare mm explicitly for every dimension and translation. STL does not encode units, so consumers must also select millimetres; there is no implicit unit conversion.

/properties/segments.explanation: Set the number of straight facets around every nominal circle:16–256, divisible by four; omission uses 64. Larger counts reduce circle approximation error but increase geometry cost. Diameter spans polygon vertices; the bore across flats is diameter*cos(pi/segments).

/properties/translation.explanation: Move the entire finished part by [X,Y,Z] millimetres after construction. Omission uses [0,0,0]. Each coordinate is between -100 and 100; this changes placement without changing dimensions or local hole coordinates.

/properties/translation/items.explanation: One signed millimetre offset in ordered X,Y,Z translation. A positive Z raises both end faces; offsets do not change thickness, bore clearance or volume.

/properties/plate.explanation: Choose plate for a rectangular mounting blank with positioned through-holes. Width/depth define the XY outline, height sets thickness, and optional holes remove material through both faces. Produces checked STL, generated SCAD and a geometry summary. Required only with operation plate; omit spacer. Dimensions are mm and local origin is the lower-left bottom corner.

/properties/plate/properties/width.explanation: Set the local X length of the rectangular plate,0.5–200 mm. The left edge is X=0 before translation; ensure all nominal hole circles plus 0.5 mm edge clearance lie inside this length.

/properties/plate/properties/depth.explanation: Set the local Y length of the rectangular plate,0.5–200 mm. The near edge is Y=0 before translation; hole centres use this local coordinate system.

/properties/plate/properties/height.explanation: Set the full Z thickness of the plate,0.5–100 mm, from local Z=0. Every hole traverses this complete thickness; blind holes are unsupported.

/properties/plate/properties/holes.explanation: List up to 16 circular through-holes. Omission or [] produces a plain plate. Nominal circles need at least 0.5 mm edge clearance and 0.5 mm separation, avoiding touching/intersecting boolean surfaces.

/properties/plate/properties/holes/items.explanation: Place one complete through-hole by its local XY centre and nominal diameter in mm. The hole is removed before whole-part translation; repeated or overlapping holes fail rather than merge.

Set [X,Y] in mm from the plate lower-left corner before translation, for example [10,10]. The complete nominal circle plus 0.5 mm must fit inside the plate; these are not global or centred coordinates.
One local millimetre coordinate, X first then Y, locating a through-hole centre. Planner clearance checks constrain it further than the numeric coordinate range.

Set nominal hole diameter across opposite polygon vertices,0.5–200 mm. The actual across-flats opening is smaller by cos(pi/segments); there is no automatic shaft-fit allowance. Shrink or move a hole to restore edge/separation clearance.

/properties/spacer.explanation: Choose spacer for a concentric sleeve or washer. Supply outer diameter, bore diameter and height in mm; it is centred on XY origin and extends upwards from Z=0. Polygonal walls approximate circles, so across-flats bore clearance differs from nominal diameter. Required only with operation spacer; omit plate. The nominal radial wall must be at least 0.5 mm.

/properties/spacer/properties/outerDiame.explanation: Set the outside nominal diameter across opposite polygon vertices,0.5–200 mm. It must exceed bore diameter by at least 1 mm. The outside across-flats diameter is slightly smaller than nominal.

/properties/spacer/properties/boreDiamet.explanation: Set the inside nominal through-bore diameter across polygon vertices,0.5–200 mm. Actual bore across flats is diameter*cos(pi/segments); choose fit clearance explicitly. Outer minus bore diameter must be at least 1 mm.

/properties/spacer/properties/height.explanation: Set spacer axial length,0.5–100 mm, from local Z=0. The concentric bore traverses the entire length. This is geometry only, with no stiffness or strength inference.

/oneOf/0.explanation: The plate branch requires operation plate and the matching dimensions object. The other part dimensions object is excluded so the native construction intention is unambiguous.

/oneOf/0/properties/operation.explanation: Choose plate for a rectangular mounting blank with positioned through-holes. Width/depth define the XY outline, height sets thickness, and optional holes remove material through both faces. Produces checked STL, generated SCAD and a geometry summary.

/oneOf/0/not.explanation: Omit the other part dimensions object when choosing plate; keep exactly one shape recipe per document.

/oneOf/1.explanation: The spacer branch requires operation spacer and the matching dimensions object. The other part dimensions object is excluded so the native construction intention is unambiguous.

/oneOf/1/properties/operation.explanation: Choose spacer for a concentric sleeve or washer. Supply outer diameter, bore diameter and height in mm; it is centred on XY origin and extends upwards from Z=0. Polygonal walls approximate circles, so across-flats bore clearance differs from nominal diameter.

/oneOf/1/not.explanation: Omit the other part dimensions object when choosing spacer; keep exactly one shape recipe per document.
